sample.topic: Lumber Operations Weekly of Vizney Timber, a fictional sawmill business: eight sawmills, four SPF mills in British Columbia and Alberta (Prince George, Kamloops, Kelowna, Red Deer) and four SYP mills in the U.S. South (Jackson, Macon, Montgomery, Shreveport), for Wk 44-26 (Oct 26 – Nov 1, 2026) against the Q4-26 plan and Wk 43-26, in US dollars. One species filter (All mills · SPF · Canada · SYP · U.S. South) drives every view
decisions: Which mills to fix first: the Outlook table, Figure 1, Table 1
Whether recovery or grade needs maintenance: Figure 2 and band 02
How to change the operating schedule for the next four weeks: Figure 3 and Table 2
Why unit cash cost rose and whether it is price or volume: Figures 4 and 5

devices.outlook: KPI block, from the investor deck's 'Outlook' and 'Q3-26 versus Q2-26' tables: an IR table in place of KPI cards. A sage head row (#5d7b59, white 13px/700; the first cell italic with the unit 'US$ unless noted'), then Wk 44-26 · Q4-26 plan · Wk 43-26 · Change · Commentary, the Commentary head in sand (#836f47). Columns tint darker to the right (#e6e7e6 → #dbdeda → #d2d8d1 → #c9d2c8 → #b8c6b7) with 2px white gaps; Commentary stays white. This week's figure is large and thin (25px/300, the annual report's big numbers), the unit in the row label ('Lumber production / MMfbm'). The plan cell holds the range ('49.5 – 52.5'), a 64px range bar (sage band, a 3px tick for this week, rust when outside the bad side) and the position in words (below · lower end · in range · upper end · above). Costs sit under a 'Costs US$/Mfbm' group row with the deck's cost arrows (↗ rust up, ↘ green down, ↔ gray) before the signed change. Negatives in parentheses
devices.takeaway: Each section ends on the deck's takeaway band: navy #39527f, one sentence in white 18px/700 italic (Korean upright, 17px), centered and balanced, with a 64px sand tile (#8d7b58) on the left that rises above the band and carries the section number (01–04) in white 22px/700. The sentence is computed from the data and says what to do, not what the chart shows
devices.ledger: Table 2, from the deck's 'Continuous Portfolio Optimization' timeline: a capacity ledger for the next four weeks. Rows are weeks (Wk 45-26 with the dates under it), columns are SPF · Canada, SYP · U.S. South and Net. Each entry leads with the signed value, green #195c2e for added volume ('+0.5'), rust #853900 in parentheses for volume taken down ('(1.2)'), then the mill in 600 and what happens ('Saturday shift', 'sawmill down Thu–Fri'). A total row closes the four weeks

parts.header: westfraser.com's header: white, a 1px #eeeeee rule; 'Vizney Timber · Wk 44-26 · Oct 26 – Nov 1, 2026' in 13.5px, the report name in green 28px/700 like an IR slide title; at the right, where the site shows its share price ('TSE WFG.TO $95.74'), a lumber price ticker ('SPF 2x4 $468 ▼6 · SYP 2x4 $412 ▲9', the label 600, US$/Mfbm under it), then EN/KO as 8px pills
parts.menu: The species filter as westfraser.com's main menu: 15.5px/600 #595959 items, the selected one a light-green pill (#e5f2eb, text #00642e, 8px radius, 38px high), the mill count after each name; 'Against plan and Wk 43-26' at the right
parts.slide: Every section reads as one IR slide: a green 24px/700 slide title with a gray kicker, a #f2f2f2 body holding white panels with 16px gaps, the navy takeaway band, then the footnote in 12px
parts.irTable: Table 1 and every table: border-spacing 2px on white, sage head row, column tints darker to the right, subtotal rows (species) in 700, indented mill rows, the state in a smaller gray '(BC)', ▼ before a figure under its target, negatives in parentheses, a sand Comments column; columns drop with width (Wk 43 and inventory under 1024px, Comments under 900px, plan, LRF and grade under 640px)
parts.figure: Panels: white, no shadow, no radius. Figure number in green 12px/700 caps → the finding as the title (17px/600 ink) → the chart title in 13px/700 with the unit in 400 '(MMfbm, Wk 44-26)' → keys → plot → note in 12px
parts.varianceTable: Figure 4, from the MD&A's adjusted EBITDA variance table: Wk 43-26 cash cost → fibre → labour → energy → maintenance and supplies → Wk 44-26 cash cost, each step signed with a small bar from a center line (rust up, green down) and a one-line reason; steps add up after rounding to $0.1
parts.smallMultiples: Figures 3 and 5, the annual report's five-year small multiples by week: earlier weeks in gray, this week in green, one shared scale across panels, the panel name left and its latest value right; Figure 3 as bars from zero inside a sage target band (9–12 days, dashed edges), Figure 5 as a line (gray #a3a3a3, the last segment and dot in green) against the plan, dashed
parts.dotTable: Figure 2: recovery and grade as dots against the species target band (#e1ebdf with a #b9cfb6 edge), the gap to the band's lower edge on the axis, the value next to its dot, rust below target; side by side when wide, stacked under 600px
parts.buttons: westfraser.com pills: 100px radius, 36px high (32px small), 15px/400 with .025em tracking; filled green #007e3a with white, or white with a green 1px border; hover #00642e or #e5f2eb
parts.tooltip: White, 1px #d9d9d9 border, 8px radius, the site's soft shadow (0 2px 16px rgba(38,38,38,.12)); the name in 13px/700, the reason in 12px gray, then value–label rows
parts.footer: #f2f2f2 with a 3px green top rule, like westfraser.com's green footer band reduced to a rule

validation.tool: dataviz validate_palette.js (OKLab), mode light, on the panel #ffffff; 2026-11-07
validation.categorical: West Fraser's charts lead with green and put the past in gray (annual report: five-year bars in #58595b, the current year #007941), with earth tones for segments (IR: sage, earth orange, sand, sky). The subject is #418d50, one step lighter and sager than the UI green #007e3a; then sky #3797c6 and plum #8c5087. All pairs: CVD worst 12.0 (deutan, plum↔green), tritan 8.0, normal-vision worst 17.0 (sky↔green); contrast 4.08, 3.34 and 5.81:1 on white. Sky drops to 2.93:1 on the #f2f2f2 slide body, so data marks always sit on white panels
validation.other: #b5c1b7 (warm grey 500) is neutral by design: CVD 20.8 and normal 24.1 against the subject green, 21.5 and 24.7 against the rust #c06228; at 1.86:1 it always comes with value labels or a table
validation.comparison: #595959 for the plan: a 2px tick in Figure 1 (#333333), dashed (5 4) in Figure 5, labelled in keys; 7.0:1
validation.below: Below plan or under target is West Fraser's earth orange #c06228 (4.18:1), not red; #a75016 for small bars and arrows on table tints. Against the subject green it is CVD 6.3 (deutan, WARN), so green and rust never meet without signs, parentheses, ▼ marks or words. For the same reason the schedule ledger encodes direction by sign and position, not by a green–orange scale
validation.history: #a3a3a3 (grey 500) for earlier weeks as a line: CVD 13.4, normal 18.1 against the subject green; 2.52:1, so the latest value is printed in the panel head and every week is in the tooltip and a table. The warm grey-green #809283 failed the normal-vision floor (10.9) against the green and was dropped
validation.sequential: one green hue #8ec294 → #20562b: monotone lightness, every gap ≥ 0.06, light end 2.04:1, hue spread 1°
validation.diverging: rust arm #e49f75 → #a14e1c (light end 2.21:1, hue spread 4°) and blue arm #8ab8e0 → #295e90 (2.10:1, 5°) around #e6e6e6; poles CVD 17.3 (protan), normal 22.6. A green–orange diverging scale fails (5.5) and is not used
validation.status: good #00642e (7.34:1), bad #a75016 (5.52:1) as text on white; on the table tints good #195c2e and bad #853900 (≥ 4.5:1 on #b8c6b7). Status always carries a sign, parentheses or ▼
validation.text: label steps: green #2d723c 5.86:1, sky #0479a6 4.89:1, plum #8c5087 5.81:1; ink #333333 12.6:1, body #595959 7.0:1, muted #666666 5.74:1; white on sage-head 4.73:1, on sand-head 4.85:1, on navy 7.81:1

code.note: a white code pane with the screen's own text steps (navy keyword, green string, rust number, plum function), all ≥ 4.5:1 on white; the highlighted line is the light green of the selected menu pill

sans.role: everything. westfraser.com sets Open Sans 400/600 (700 declared), an open typeface, so the English screen uses it as is; the IR deck's Arial and the annual report's Helvetica Neue are not used. There is no Korean westfraser.com, so Korean uses Pretendard, upright where English is italic

mono.role: code and file names in How it's built only; figures on the screen stay in Open Sans with tabular numerals

chartTitle.note: the unit after it in 400 #595959, in parentheses

outlookValue.note: thin like the annual report's big numbers, the % in 13px; costs 19px; 20px and 16px on phones

layout.header: 76px white header (sample name, period, report name; the lumber price ticker; EN/KO) + 54px species menu
rows: 01 Wk 44-26 versus Wk 43-26: the Outlook table (1.75fr) beside Figure 1 production vs plan by mill (1fr), bottoms aligned; band 01; the plan note
02 Mill results: Table 1 across, then Figure 2 recovery and grade against target across; band 02
03 Running to demand: Figure 3 inventory days (two small multiples) beside Table 2 the schedule ledger, bottoms aligned; band 03
04 Unit cash cost: Figure 4 the variance table beside Figure 5 cash cost by week; band 04
05 How it's built: the package, Figure 1 drawn step by step with the checks, the code in five tabs
06 How the numbers are counted: terms and sources in two columns
footer: VIZNEY STYLES · 07 with the catalog link, sample note, notice, the back link
layout.responsive: 1360px and up as above with 32px margins; 1280–1359px the same with 24px margins; under 1280px the Outlook table and Figure 1 stack, and so do Figure 3 and Table 2 (so the inventory panels are not stretched to the ledger's height); under 1024px Figures 4 and 5 stack and table columns drop; under 640px one column with 16px margins, Figure 2 stacks its two dot columns; under 480px the Outlook table drops the change column and the ledger scrolls

tableau.fonts: Open Sans for text if it is installed on authoring and viewing machines and the server; otherwise Tableau Book
tableau.notes: Figure 1 is a bar chart with a per-cell reference line for plan (solid 2px #333333, no label), bars colored by [vs_plan_mmfbm] < 0 (#c06228) or not (#b5c1b7), sorted by the gap. Tables: header shading #5d7b59 with white bold text, the Comments header #836f47, column shading stepping #e6e7e6 → #b8c6b7, number format #,##0.0;(#,##0.0). Finding as the title, the chart title with the unit as the subtitle. The takeaway band is a text object, navy #39527f, white bold italic

powerbi.notes: Clustered bar chart with error bars at plan (markers on, dash, #333333) and conditional bar colors by rule; table and matrix headers #5d7b59 with white bold text; negatives as (#,0.0); the takeaway band as a text box on navy #39527f

measured.web: westfraser.com (Drupal + Tailwind): body 16/21.76px Open Sans #595959 on white; headings #333333 600 (64/76.8, 32/38.4, 28/33.6, 20/24px); CSS custom properties for green (100 #e5f2eb … 500 #007e3a, 600 #00642e, 700 #004b22), grey (100 #f2f2f2, 200 #e6e6e6, 300 #bfbfbf, 500 #a3a3a3, 700 #595959, 800 #333333), sage-green (50 #f0f5ef, 100 #e1ebdf, 300 #b9cfb6, 500 #749470), earth-orange (500 #c06228, 600 #a75016), sandy-brown (500 #a8936a, 600 #8d7b58), warm-grey (500 #b5c1b7), navy (500 #39527f), sky-blue (500 #3797c6, 600 #0479a6); the main menu 16px/600 with the current item as a #e5f2eb pill (8px radius, text #00642e); pill buttons (100px radius, 34px, 16px/400, .4px tracking), filled #007e3a or outlined; a share ticker in the header ('TSE WFG.TO $95.74 · NYSE WFG $67.86'); 'Quick facts' tiles with green numbers; borders mostly 1px #eeeeee; shadow 0 2px 16px rgba(38,38,38,.08); a green footer. Canadian spelling (fibre, labour)
measured.irDeck: Q3 2026 investor presentation (November 2026, 960 × 540 slides): green bold slide titles; tables with a sage head row (#749370, white bold, the first cell italic 'US$ millions unless otherwise indicated'), a sand Comments head (#a8936a), column tints #e6e7e6 → #dbdeda → #c9d2c8 → #b8c6b7 with white gaps, negatives as (26), units in the row label ('(MMfbm)'); the '2026 Outlook' with forecast ranges and Commentary, and cost lines (Fibre, Transportation, Labour, Resin) with earth-orange arrows; a navy takeaway band (#39527f, bold italic white) with a sand or sage tile at its left; segment panels in sage, earth orange, sand and sky; the 'Continuous Portfolio Optimization' ledger ('+300 Angelina (TX) acquisition' green, '–110 Lake Butler (FL) indefinite curtailment' orange); bar charts with a dashed average line labelled at the end and a 'Source:' line
measured.mdna: Q3-26 management's discussion and analysis: period labels Q3-26, Q2-26, YTD-26; '$ millions unless otherwise indicated'; SPF (MMfbm) and SYP (MMfbm) production and shipments; an adjusted EBITDA variance table (comparative period → price → volume → changes in costs → inventory write-downs → other → current period); words such as unit manufacturing costs, log costs, freight, operating schedules, operating rates, curtailment, downtime, run mills to demand
measured.annualReport: Annual Report 2025 (March 2026): five-year small multiples with past years in dark gray (#58595b) and the current year in green (#007941), a bold title with the unit as a subtitle ('in MMfbm'); big numbers in a thin weight ('275 MMfbm Capacity')
measured.sustainability: Sustainability Report 2025: goal status legend Complete · On Track · Not On Track · Not Complete in green and orange; highlight tiles with an arrow and a short line ('↓25% in Scope 1 and 2 emissions')
measured.realWorld: wrapped lumber units on trucks, railcars and yards (white wrap with repeating logo marks): seen, not used; the logo, wordmark, photos and the investor deck's exact figures are not carried over
